chapter: Postwar Chicago, Janis and De Paris
title: Rhythm section with De Paris and being let go
summary: The band got along, but Moore was replaced because they wanted a New Orleans drummer; he declined to return after Zutty's brief stint.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Now, was it an easy band to play in? Did everybody get along with one another?

Yeah, they got along fine! The (?) had a good piano player, Don Kirkpatrick, who played piano in Chick Webb's band. Eddie Gibbs... He had a good rhythm section. We all linked up together. Because the front line is down on the level floor, almost on the level floor, and we had a separate stage in back for the rhythm. The rhythm was right there together, man, because we were right next to one another. We were right together. The rhythm was all right. But they let me out because they said they wanted a New Orleans drummer.
So you weren't New Orleans enough for them.

No. So after I left, they got Zutty Singleton. Zutty lasted about three months. After they got rid of him, there was another drummer who tried it, couldn't make it. Then Wilbur called me and wanted me to come back in the band. And I said, 'Unh-uh. Once I'm... You fire me one time, you won't have a chance to fire me a second time. I don't want to come back no more.' So I didn't go back.
And a little while after, about a year, he passed away. No, his brother passed away first.

Sidney. I was down at the union to collect some money, some checks or something, and I see Wilbur down there, and he has tears coming down... I said, "What's the matter, Wilbur?" "I lost Sidney, my brother." After that... After him, he took all the (?) out, and he just give it up. He had a good band, though.

But when I did (?) kind of singing... You mentioned earlier the "Saints" recording date. As fast as I could play. But it was the first time when I... How fast can you play (?). You can play as fast as you wanted to. [PATS A STEADY FOUR] See, that's my speed. So I took four bars, was going... [SINGS RAUCOUS TEMPO]
